ios-patterns|Managing accounts.summary: Plenix on iOS signs people in, up and back in with the system’s own help: Sign in with Apple and passkeys first where the service offers them, the password fields that the system’s password manager and the one-time-code autofill understand (textContentType username, password, newPassword, oneTimeCode), and the session ending with an alert that keeps the work. Plenix styles what the app draws: the form on the grouped surface with the Plenix field border and fill, the primary button as wide as the form at the touch height, one general error above the fields, the links to the other flows as plain buttons, and every account’s connection as a row with its status in words. Apple’s default is a plain Form; Plenix keeps its structure and the system sheets and changes the look.

variants.name: Sign in
variants.apple: Form with TextField(.username) and SecureField(.password); ASAuthorizationController for passkeys
variants.swiftui: PlenixSignIn(onSubmit: signIn): TextField with .textContentType(.username), SecureField with .textContentType(.password), a full-width prominent button
variants.uikit: UITextField.textContentType = .username and .password in a UIStackView on the grouped background
variants.appkit: NSTextField and NSSecureTextField with contentType (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: The entry to every signed-in part of the app.

variants.name: Sign up
variants.apple: Form with .newPassword and the system’s strong password suggestion
variants.swiftui: SecureField with .textContentType(.newPassword) and the rule as a footer Text in the Plenix muted color
variants.appkit: NSSecureTextField with contentType .newPassword (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: Creating an account with only what is needed now.

variants.name: Two-step code
variants.apple: One TextField with .oneTimeCode (the code from Messages fills it)
variants.swiftui: TextField("Code", text: $code).textContentType(.oneTimeCode).keyboardType(.numberPad), the digit boxes of the Digit entry views page
variants.appkit: NSTextField with contentType .oneTimeCode (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: The second step after the password.

variants.name: Single sign-on
variants.apple: SignInWithAppleButton and ASWebAuthenticationSession for the organization’s provider
variants.swiftui: SignInWithAppleButton(.continue) styled by the system; other providers as Plenix secondary buttons that open ASWebAuthenticationSession
variants.appkit: ASAuthorizationAppleIDButton (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: Organizations that sign in with their own provider.

variants.name: Session timeout
variants.apple: An alert before the session ends
variants.swiftui: .alert("Your session is about to end", isPresented: $warning) { Button("Sign out", role: .destructive) { … }; Button("Stay signed in") { … } }
variants.uikit: UIAlertController(title:message:preferredStyle: .alert) with the preferred action Stay signed in
variants.appkit: NSAlert with Stay signed in first (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

variants.name: Account connection
variants.apple: A List row per service with its status and a button
variants.swiftui: List { ForEach(accounts) { PlenixAccountRow(account: $0) } }, Connect opening ASWebAuthenticationSession
variants.uikit: UICollectionView list with a custom cell per service
variants.appkit: NSTableView rows (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: The services the app is linked to, in Settings.
